newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: One- to six-mth Saudi t-bills flat, year drops.
newsitem.headline: One- to six-mth Saudi t-bills flat, year drops.

text.p: Yields on one- to six-month Saudi treasury bills were steady on Tuesday, but the rate on one-year bills fell, bankers said.

The yield on 28-day bills was steady at 5.3585 percent, the rate on 91-day paper was 5.4836 and the yield on 182-day bills was 5.6097 percent. But the rate on 364-day bills fell to 5.7994 from 5.8774 percent.
The Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency bills, worth a total two billion riyals, were priced at 99.58496, 98.63281, 97.24219 and 94.46940.
One-month interbank deposits were at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent, three months 5-5/8, 1/2 percent, six months at 5-11/16, 9/16 percent and one-year were quoted at 5-15/16, 13/16 percent.
